spec.title: Top Genres
spec.description: Top artists for the selected Grafana time range.

spec.rawSql:
with aggregated as (
  select
    g.name as genre,
    count(distinct s.id)::bigint as listened_count
  from music.scrobbles s
  join music.track_genres tg on tg.track_id = s.track_id
  join music.genres g on g.id = tg.genre_id
  where $__timeFilter(s.scrobbled_at)
  group by
    g.id,
    g.name
)
select
  row_number() over (order by listened_count desc, genre) as rank,
  genre,
  listened_count
from aggregated
order by rank;

with aggregated as (
  select
    g.name as genre,
    count(distinct s.id)::bigint as listened_count
  from music.scrobbles s
  join music.track_genres tg on tg.track_id = s.track_id
  join music.genres g on g.id = tg.genre_id
  where $__timeFilter(s.scrobbled_at)
  group by
    g.id,
    g.name
)
select genre as value
from aggregated
order by listened_count desc, genre
limit 1;

select count(distinct album_id)::bigint as value
from music.scrobbles
where $__timeFilter(scrobbled_at)
  and album_id is not null;

select
  $__timeGroupAlias(scrobbled_at, '1d'),
  count(*)::bigint as plays
from music.scrobble_events
where $__timeFilter(scrobbled_at)
group by 1
order by 1;

select
  scrobbled_at,
  artist,
  album,
  track,
  track_url,
  coalesce(track_image_url, album_image_url, artist_image_url) as art,
  source
from music.scrobble_events
where $__timeFilter(scrobbled_at)
order by scrobbled_at desc
limit 100;

spec.title: Top Played Songs
spec.description: Top songs for the selected Grafana time range.

spec.rawSql:
with aggregated as (
  select
    coalesce(t.image_url, al.image_url) as track_art,
    a.name as artist,
    al.name as album,
    t.name as track,
    array_to_string(coalesce(track_tags.tags, '{}'::text[]), ', ') as track_genres,
    count(*)::bigint as listened_count,
    min(s.scrobbled_at) as first_listened,
    max(s.scrobbled_at) as last_listened,
    t.url as track_url
  from music.scrobbles s
  join music.artists a on a.id = s.artist_id
  join music.tracks t on t.id = s.track_id
  left join music.albums al on al.id = s.album_id
  left join lateral (
    select array_agg(g.name order by tg.weight desc nulls last, g.name) as tags
    from music.track_genres tg
    join music.genres g on g.id = tg.genre_id
    where tg.track_id = t.id
  ) track_tags on true
  where $__timeFilter(s.scrobbled_at)
  group by
    a.id,
    a.name,
    al.id,
    al.name,
    al.image_url,
    t.id,
    t.name,
    t.url,
    t.image_url,
    track_tags.tags
)
select
  row_number() over (order by listened_count desc, last_listened desc, artist, track) as rank,
  track_art,
  artist,
  album,
  track,
  track_genres,
  listened_count,
  first_listened,
  last_listened,
  track_url
from aggregated
order by rank;

spec.title: Top Played Albums
spec.description: Top albums for the selected Grafana time range.

spec.rawSql:
with aggregated as (
  select
    al.image_url as album_art,
    a.name as artist,
    al.name as album,
    array_to_string(coalesce(album_tags.tags, '{}'::text[]), ', ') as album_genres,
    count(*)::bigint as listened_count,
    min(s.scrobbled_at) as first_listened,
    max(s.scrobbled_at) as last_listened,
    al.url as album_url
  from music.scrobbles s
  join music.artists a on a.id = s.artist_id
  join music.albums al on al.id = s.album_id
  left join lateral (
    select array_agg(g.name order by alg.weight desc nulls last, g.name) as tags
    from music.album_genres alg
    join music.genres g on g.id = alg.genre_id
    where alg.album_id = al.id
  ) album_tags on true
  where $__timeFilter(s.scrobbled_at)
  group by
    a.id,
    a.name,
    al.id,
    al.name,
    al.url,
    al.image_url,
    album_tags.tags
)
select
  row_number() over (order by listened_count desc, last_listened desc, artist, album) as rank,
  album_art,
  artist,
  album,
  album_genres,
  listened_count,
  first_listened,
  last_listened,
  album_url
from aggregated
order by rank;

spec.title: Top Played Artists
spec.description: Top artists for the selected Grafana time range.

spec.rawSql:
with aggregated as (
  select
    a.image_url as artist_art,
    a.name as artist,
    count(*)::bigint as listened_count,
    min(s.scrobbled_at) as first_listened,
    max(s.scrobbled_at) as last_listened,
    a.url as artist_url
  from music.scrobbles s
  join music.artists a on a.id = s.artist_id
  where $__timeFilter(s.scrobbled_at)
  group by
    a.id,
    a.name,
    a.url,
    a.image_url
)
select
  row_number() over (order by listened_count desc, last_listened desc, artist) as rank,
  artist_art,
  artist,
  listened_count,
  first_listened,
  last_listened,
  artist_url
from aggregated
order by rank;
